headline: Drake @champagnepapi wins $1 million on Stake after betting $650,000 on UFC fighter Joshua
body: Drake @champagnepapi wins $1 million on Stake after betting $650,000 on UFC fighter Joshua Van to beat Alexandre Pantoja last night. Van dominated the fight on Sept. 19, securing a unanimous decision victory to retain the men’s flyweight title. The rapper seemed to take a risk when he initially made his choice. “I don’t know bro… but he better win ,” he posted with his bet slip. Did you think Van would win? Powered by.
